needs.title: What a website for a fashion brand has to deliver.
needs.description: A fashion brand is not understood through a product list but through attitude, imagery and rhythm. The website is often the first place where all of that comes together.

items.title: Atmosphere before catalogue
items.description: The first impression decides whether a brand lands. Imagery, typography and pace say more than a list of items.

items.title: A collection told clearly
items.description: Campaign, lookbook and individual pieces need a structure in which visitors move intuitively without losing the thread.

items.title: Mobile first
items.description: Many visitors arrive straight from social media on their phone. Images have to load fast, and the page has to feel right there.

example.title: NØFORM: a fictional streetwear brand as an example.

faq.title: What you'd want to know beforehand.

items.question: How much does a website for a fashion brand cost?
items.answer: It depends on the scope: number of pages, image material, languages and special features. Our packages and prices give you an orientation. You receive a concrete offer after a short conversation, without obligation.

items.question: Do I need my own online shop for that?
items.answer: Not necessarily. Many brands start with a brand presence made of campaign and lookbook and link to an existing shop. If you want to sell directly, we will talk about which solution makes sense.

items.question: Is NØFORM a real client project?
items.answer: No. NØFORM is a fictional brand that we built as a concept project to show our work on a fashion topic. Concept projects are labelled as such in the portfolio.

items.question: Can the website be multilingual?
items.answer: Yes. Labrity itself is built in four languages, and NØFORM exists in three. A clean structure allows search engines to match each language version correctly.

items.question: What material do I need to get started?
items.answer: Ideally images or campaign material, a logo and a short description of your brand. If not everything exists yet, we clarify in a conversation what is missing and how we proceed.
